name: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited
summary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited builds financial products and solutions to manage the business expenses of corporates, small and medium-sized enterprises, and startups through automated workflows. It operates Propel, a corporate software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform for channel rewards and incentives, employee rewards, and recognition; and Save, a SaaS-based platform and a mobile application to offer expense management solution for business spend management facilitating digitized employee reimbursements and tax benefits.
